producthunt.name: Pexo
producthunt.tagline: Produce pitch perfect launch videos with precise control
producthunt.description: Pexo makes creating your launch video as simple as having a conversation. Share your product, website, or assets. It plans the story, chooses the right AI model for each task, generates and assembles the scenes, and handles voiceover, music, captions, motion graphics, and editing. Leave a comment or circle what you want changed, and Pexo makes the edit. You direct one agent from idea to a finished, on-brand launch video.

producthunt.name: Ferndesk
producthunt.tagline: The help center that never goes out of date
producthunt.description: Ferndesk is a complete help center with an agent that checks every article against your product, catches what changed, and drafts the fixes for you.

producthunt.name: SaleSmartly
producthunt.tagline: Turn conversations across every channel into customers
producthunt.description: SaleSmartly brings customer conversations from WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, TikTok, Telegram, LINE, WeChat and more into one workspace. Manage leads with a built-in CRM, let AI agents answer questions and qualify customers 24/7, translate conversations in real time, and automate follow-ups—all while your team keeps the context needed to turn more conversations into customers.
